info.title: agentsd
info.description: The methods a host (agentsd) answers, sent to it with `h`. Every method's params are its one `params` value, sent as JSON-RPC's whole params (an object, or for a few a bare value), as DaemonAPI sends them. A method with `x-notification` has no result: the server sends it. The `web` tag marks what the web page calls and hears (DaemonAPI.WebSignatures); a method a Go step ports joins with its types, schema first.

x-declared-capabilities.name: host.wire/1
x-declared-capabilities.description: A host says machine/hello with its capabilities on each connect (#1748). The control plane requires it of hosts.

x-declared-capabilities.name: agents.move-worktree/1
x-declared-capabilities.description: The host serves the app tool move_worktree to the runtimes that can move (#1821): an agent moves into a new or existing worktree of its folder when its turn ends, and back with leave_worktree remove, which removes the worktree once its work is pushed. An app tool, not a method, so declared.

x-declared-capabilities.name: host.team/1
x-declared-capabilities.description: A host knows the user it belongs to (#994, #1763). On a control plane with more than one person, a host without it is needsUpdate, and calls to it are answered -32074 updateToJoinTeam (R14).

x-declared-capabilities.name: host.suspend/1
x-declared-capabilities.description: The host hears user/suspended (#1002, FR-018): it stops its person's running turns, pauses their workflows and queued prompts, refuses new work and the window's direct path, and keeps every agent and file; off: true ends the pause. It keeps the state in <root>/suspended.json. A notification it hears, not a method it serves, so declared.

x-declared-capabilities.name: host.policy-layers/1
x-declared-capabilities.description: A host resolves the effective policy from the organisation, your and a folder's layers through policylayers.Resolve (#2957), instead of only the organisation's ceiling. Declared so slice 2's policy/effective, policy/yours and policy/setYours, and the organisation's new rules of FR-003, have a capability to require.

x-declared-capabilities.name: host.browser-settings/1
x-declared-capabilities.description: The host serves browser/state and browser/clear (#3535): Settings ▸ Browser, the sites the machine's browser keeps cookies for, Clear, and the size of the Chromium download.

x-declared-capabilities.name: host.secret-approval/1
x-declared-capabilities.description: The host keeps a secret with Ask before use sealed to this machine's key (#4014), never in secrets.env or a session's file as plain text: an agent's ask_secret, generate_secret and mcp/set-secret turn it on, and secrets/setNeedsApproval lets a person's client turn it on or off.

x-declared-capabilities.name: host.secret-grants/1
x-declared-capabilities.description: A use of a secret with Ask before use (fill_secret, set_ci_secret) waits on a person's approval (#4015): a request of kind approve, answered Approve, Approve for This Session, Always Approve or Deny by the control and device roles. secrets/grants, secrets/addGrant and secrets/removeGrant keep the Always Approve places.

x-declared-capabilities.name: host.session-secrets/1
x-declared-capabilities.description: The host keeps secrets for one session only (#3548): an ask_secret answer with sessionOnly, and secrets/sessionList, secrets/sessionSet and secrets/sessionRemove for Settings ▸ Secrets. Only that session's agent can use one, and the host deletes it when the session is archived.

x-declared-capabilities.name: host.desktop-control/1
x-declared-capabilities.description: The host serves the app tool drive_screen (#3004, US1): an agent drives an app on this Mac through its own screen, mouse and keyboard, holding the screen lease while it does, only while the person has turned desktop control on (desktopControl/state, desktopControl/set): Ask, the default on a machine a person uses, asks a person before each lease of the screen (#4264). Mac only.

x-declared-capabilities.name: host.drive-approval/1
x-declared-capabilities.description: Browser and Desktop control are Ask, Always Approve or Off (#4264): with Ask, an agent's lease of the browser or the screen waits on a request of kind approve (secretUse, use browser or screen), answered Approve (this lease), Approve for This Session, Always Approve (the setting) or Deny. browserControl/state and browserControl/set are the browser's; desktopControl's settings carry mode.

x-declared-capabilities.name: host.org-routes/2
x-declared-capabilities.description: The host keeps org routes as an admin's client sealed them to its own key (#3397, specs/3397-client-sealing): it opens each with associated data orgroute.v3, refuses a lower seal version than it holds, shows a route it has no copy of as waiting, makes its own token from a cloud credential, and answers machine/orgRouteCheck. The control plane sends machine/orgRoutes only to a host that says it. Declared: its methods are the control plane's (control.openrpc.json).

x-declared-capabilities.name: host.user-settings/1
x-declared-capabilities.description: The host writes machine/userSettings into its files (#1760). Declared since settings/userPart took host.user-settings/3 (#4100), so a control plane still pushes to it.

x-declared-capabilities.name: host.user-settings/2
x-declared-capabilities.description: The host opens its person's secrets as their client sealed them to its own key (#3397), with associated data usersecret.v1, and refuses a lower version than it holds. Only a host that says it is sent its secrets in machine/userSettings. Declared: machine/userSettings is the control plane's (control.openrpc.json).

x-declared-capabilities.name: host.lock/1
x-declared-capabilities.description: The host checks its person's machine lock (#3399, specs/3399-machine-lock) as machine/lock sends it, and pins the head: it takes a lock only when it grows from the head it pinned last. Until #3400's later steps it refuses nothing and only logs what it would refuse. Declared: machine/lock is the control plane's (control.openrpc.json).

x-declared-capabilities.name: host.lock/2
x-declared-capabilities.description: The host joins its person's lock (#3491, specs/3399-machine-lock D3): with an invite key from its join code it signs its own addMachine (machine/lockAdd); with none it asks (machine/lockJoin), and shows the six digits once a signer answered (machine/lockJoinChanged). Declared: those methods are the control plane's (control.openrpc.json).
